email.body1:
Jack, saw HSI launched its Sky AI assistant and added the Enhesa-powered regulatory module this year.

A broader platform usually means more accounts in your region than the team can work before interest cools, and that gap is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jack, quick follow-up for HSI.

With Sky and the new regulatory module, the addressable list grows faster than a regional team can touch. Most leaders don't actually know how many meetings each rep needs to convert that demand, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HSI needs to keep your territory covered without hiring more reps.
email.body3:
Jack, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jack, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional coverage without adding reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out a new AI assistant and module is its own kind of busy, and timing matters most here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to HSI either way.
